stories.title: Un testimone sul volo Dubai-Tel Aviv: “Abbiamo immobilizzato l’assalitore con i cavi delle cuffie”

en.title: Witness on Dubai-Tel Aviv flight: "We immobilized the attacker with headphone cables"
en.summary: A passenger on a flight between Dubai and Tel Aviv reported that several travelers restrained an alleged assailant using headphone cables during an altercation aboard the aircraft.

stories.title: Occhiuto punge Tajani: “Forse sua comunicazione andrebbe rivista, Forza Italia un po’ ingiallita”

en.title: Occhiuto criticizes Tajani: "Perhaps his communication should be revised, Forza Italia somewhat outdated"
en.summary: The president of Calabria region presented his book and made comments about the communication style of the Forza Italia party leadership.

stories.title: Occhiuto, aprire a modernità e forse comunicazione di Tajani andrebbe rivista

en.title: Occhiuto, open to modernity and perhaps Tajani's communication should be revised
en.summary: The regional governor advocated for a modern and open direction for the party.

stories.title: Legge elettorale, Meloni alla prova dell'Aula domani il voto sulle pregiudiziali

en.title: Electoral law, Meloni faces parliamentary test tomorrow vote on preliminary objections
en.summary: The government prepared for a parliamentary vote on electoral reform while opposition parties requested secret voting procedures and one party confirmed its opposition.

stories.title: Bozza, bando-tipo del Mit per i balneari, concessioni da 5 a 20 anni

en.title: Draft, MIT standard tender for beach establishments, concessions from 5 to 20 years
en.summary: The Italian Ministry of Infrastructure has drafted a standard tender model for beach concessions lasting between 5 and 20 years, including compensation for outgoing operators and limits on license concentration.

stories.title: 'Su Ustica nuove indagini', la Procura ritira l'archiviazione

en.title: 'New investigations on Ustica', the Prosecutor withdraws the dismissal
en.summary: A prosecutor has withdrawn an archival dismissal in the Ustica case following a development from Paris, signaling that the investigation will continue.

stories.title: Volo Dubai-Tel Aviv, le drammatiche immagini dalla cabina dopo l'assalto: "Aiutateci"

en.title: Dubai-Tel Aviv flight, dramatic images from cabin after assault: "Help us"
en.summary: A Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv was diverted to Saudi Arabia after an incident involving two injured men on the aircraft. The cause remains disputed, with claims of terrorism and an Israeli official attributing it to a physical confrontation between pilots.

stories.title: Legge elettorale: via libera per l'Aula da parte della commissione Affari costituzionali

en.title: Electoral law: approval from the Chamber by the Constitutional Affairs commission
en.summary: The Constitutional Affairs commission has approved an electoral law measure for discussion in the Chamber of Deputies, with general debate scheduled for this afternoon and preliminary objections planned for tomorrow.

stories.title: Copilota tenta di dirottare il volo Dubai-Tel Aviv. Netanyahu: “A quanto pare intendeva far precipitare l’aereo”

en.title: Co-pilot attempts to hijack Dubai-Tel Aviv flight. Netanyahu: "Apparently intended to crash the plane"
en.summary: A FlyDubai co-pilot allegedly stabbed the captain during a Dubai-Tel Aviv flight carrying over 150 passengers. Israeli security agencies suspect Iranian involvement in what they characterize as a potential terror attack, and the aircraft made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: Istat, maxi balzo dell’inflazione: 4,2% a settembre. Cala la fiducia di consumatori e imprese

en.title: Istat, major surge in inflation: 4.2% in September. Consumer and business confidence decline
en.summary: Italian inflation rose sharply to 4.2 percent in September, driven by a significant surge in energy prices. Industrial data showed a decline after three consecutive months of growth.

stories.title: Legge elettorale, rush finale e tensioni: limiti alle vedette in aula. Magi in sciopero della fame

en.title: Electoral law, final rush and tensions: restrictions on floor observers. Magi on hunger strike
en.summary: Italian lawmakers are debating new electoral law measures that will restrict how majority parties can monitor potentially dissident deputies during parliamentary sessions. Press staff will retain access through side entrances.

stories.title: Volo Dubai-Tel Aviv: bloccato un pilota armato di coltello. Israele: “Attacco jihadista, evitato un altro 11 settembre”

en.title: Dubai-Tel Aviv flight: armed pilot stopped with knife. Israel: "Jihadist attack, another 9/11 averted"
en.summary: A FlyDubai aircraft reported an emergency while traveling from the United Arab Emirates to Tel Aviv. The plane landed in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, after a pilot armed with a knife was stopped; Israeli officials characterized the incident as a thwarted jihadist attack.

stories.title: Aeroporto di Genova, per l’Autorità portuale vale tra 15 e 16 milioni

en.title: Genoa Airport valued between 15 and 16 million euros by Port Authority
en.summary: The Port Authority has assessed the value of Genoa's Cristoforo Colombo Airport, which operates as a joint-stock company, at between 14.9 and 15.9 million euros.

stories.title: Podcast: 18,5 milioni di ascoltatori e la scoperta passa dai social

en.title: Podcast: 18.5 million listeners and discovery passes through social media
en.summary: Podcasts have become an established part of daily life for Italians, integrated into commutes and work routines. The medium continues to grow its audience year-over-year.

stories.title: Patrik Jonsson (Eli Lilly): «Scienze della vita e terapie innovative. L’Italia investa sulla prevenzione»

en.title: Patrik Jonsson (Eli Lilly): "Life sciences and innovative therapies. Italy should invest in prevention"
en.summary: The Eli Lilly executive vice president urges Italy to prioritize preventive therapies and life sciences investments, noting that the United States and China are advancing while Europe risks losing competitive advantage.

stories.title: Produttività al palo per le Pmi

en.title: Productivity stalled for SMEs
en.summary: A Cerved analysis covering 2019-2025 shows Italian small and medium enterprises increased in number and employment but experienced declining productivity levels.

stories.title: Accordo tra Tarros e Nurminen per nuovo corridoio intermodale Italia-Svezia

en.title: Agreement between Tarros and Nurminen for new Italy-Sweden intermodal corridor
en.summary: Italian company Tarros and Finnish logistics firm Nurminen have signed a commercial and operational agreement to establish a new intermodal transport corridor connecting Sweden and Italy.
